Dialog.Dxvk.WarningContent:
⚠ ADVANCED FEATURE — USE AT YOUR OWN RISK

DXVK is an unofficial DirectX-to-Vulkan translation layer.
No support will be provided if a game is not compatible.

WHO SHOULD USE THIS:
• Primarily benefits older DX8/DX9 games (e.g. FFXIV, Morrowind)
• Enables ReShade compute shaders on games that don't support them natively
• Can reduce CPU-bound stuttering in older titles

IMPORTANT WARNINGS:
• Anti-cheat games may ban players using DXVK
• Game overlays (Steam, NVIDIA, RTSS) may conflict or stop working
• Exclusive fullscreen is blocked — use borderless windowed
• First launch will be slow due to shader compilation (improves on subsequent runs)
• Some games may crash or have graphical glitches with DXVK

Do you want to continue?
Dialog.DxvkInfo.Content:
DXVK translates DirectX 8/9/10/11 API calls into Vulkan.

Benefits:
• Enables ReShade compute shaders on older DX games
• May improve performance and reduce shader stutter
• Enables HDR output via dxvk.conf
• Borderless fullscreen recommended over exclusive fullscreen

⚠ Anti-cheat games may ban players using DXVK.
⚠ Game overlays (Steam, NVIDIA, RTSS) may conflict.

Dialog.FullRefresh.Content:
This will clear all caches and re-scan everything from scratch:

• Re-detects all games from every storefront
• Re-scans DLSS/Streamline DLL paths
• Re-detects graphics APIs and engine types
• Rebuilds shader and addon deployment state

Try a normal Refresh first — it handles most issues without the full rescan. Use Full Refresh as a last resort if games are missing, paths have changed, DLSS has been added to a game, or the DLSS section is missing from a game card.

The next couple of restarts may take a few seconds longer while caches are rebuilt.

Do not close RHI while the refresh is in progress — closing early will result in a missing library and the scan will need to be repeated.

Dialog.LumaRenodxCombinedWarning.Content:
Heads up — you're installing both RenoDX and Luma on this game.

There's no guarantee they'll work well together. If you're using RenoDX for HDR and just want Luma for DLAA, make sure to disable HDR in the Luma mod settings to avoid conflicts.

If something doesn't look right, uninstalling one of them is the first thing to try. We can't offer support for issues that come from running both together.

Overrides.Dlss.PresetTooltip.Rr: Override the Ray Reconstruction denoising model. Higher presets are newer model iterations. NVIDIA Recommended uses NVIDIA's per-resolution preset selection.
Overrides.Dlss.PresetTooltip.Sr: Override the DLSS upscaling model. J/K use the 1st-gen transformer (DLSS 4.0). L/M use the 2nd-gen transformer (DLSS 4.5) with better temporal stability. NVIDIA Recommended uses NVIDIA's per-resolution preset selection.

Overrides.FlipPacing.Tooltip: Flip Pacing — Off: prioritize lower latency. On: prioritize smoother frame pacing. Sets both fullscreen and windowed modes together.
Overrides.GSync.Tooltip: Per-game G-Sync control. Disabled forces G-Sync off for this game regardless of global setting.
Overrides.GameName.Tooltip: The display name for this game. Edit and press Enter to rename. Reset reverts to the auto-detected store name.
Overrides.LaunchArgs.EpicNote: Note: Setting arguments disables Epic protocol launch. EOS-protected games may fail to launch with arguments.
Overrides.LaunchArgs.Tooltip: Command-line arguments passed to the game on launch. Saves on focus lost.
Overrides.LaunchExe.BrowseTooltip: Browse for a game executable to use as the launch target.
Overrides.LaunchExe.ResetTooltip: Clear the launch executable override and revert to auto-detection.
Overrides.LaunchExe.Tooltip: Override the executable used when launching this game. Leave blank for auto-detection (largest exe in install folder).
Overrides.LiliumPreset.Tooltip:
Controls how aggressively DXVK upgrades render targets for HDR.

Safest = swap chain only (near 100% compatible).
Higher tiers upgrade back buffers and render targets — better HDR but may cause visual issues.
Overrides.LowLatency.Tooltip: Low Latency Mode — Off: game controls frame queue. On: limits pre-rendered frames to 1 (lower latency). Ultra: just-in-time frame submission (lowest latency, may reduce FPS slightly).
Overrides.LowLatency.Tooltip.Locked: Low Latency is locked to Ultra while Smooth Motion is enabled. Turn off Smooth Motion to change this setting.
Overrides.Mfg.Tooltip: Configure NVIDIA Multi Frame Generation: mode, frame count multiplier, and dynamic target frame rate. Requires 50 Series GPU.

Overrides.Power.Tooltip: Power management, G-Sync control, and profile reset.
Overrides.PowerMode.Tooltip: Power Management — Adaptive: GPU clocks down at idle. Maximum: locks GPU to highest clocks. Optimal: balanced (NVIDIA recommended).
Overrides.Rebar.Tooltip: Resizable BAR — allows the CPU to access full GPU VRAM at once. Can improve performance by 5-10% in some titles. RTX 30+ and BIOS support required.
Overrides.RebarEnable.Tooltip: Off = ReBAR disabled. On = Force-enable ReBAR for this game.
Overrides.RebarEnable.Tooltip.Global: Global = inherit from global setting. On/Off = per-game override.
Overrides.RebarMode.Tooltip: Standard = conservative. Optimized = aggressive driver scheduling (used by NVIDIA-whitelisted titles).
Overrides.RebarSize.Tooltip: 1GB is optimal for most games. Decrease to 512MB if experiencing ReBAR-related stutters.
Overrides.RemoveGame.Tooltip: Reset the install folder to auto-detected, or remove a manually added game entirely.
Overrides.ResetName.Tooltip: Reset game name back to auto-detected and clear wiki name mapping.
Overrides.ResetOverrides.Tooltip: Reset all per-game overrides back to defaults (DLL names, channels, shaders, addons, DXVK, launch settings, update inclusion).
Overrides.RestoreProfile.Tooltip: Restore this game's NVIDIA driver profile to factory defaults. Removes all custom settings (presets, render scale, MFG, driver overrides). This action is irreversible.
Overrides.RsName.Tooltip: Override the ReShade DLL name. OptiScaler is installed — RHI will rename ReShade to this filename after OptiScaler is uninstalled.
Overrides.SelectPreset.Tooltip: Pick .ini preset files to copy to this game's folder. Place presets in the reshade-presets folder.
Overrides.ShaderMode.Tooltip: Global = use global shader selection. Custom = use custom shader directories. Select = pick per-game packs. Off = no shaders.
Overrides.SmoothMotion.Tooltip: NVIDIA Smooth Motion — driver-level frame generation. Adds interpolated frames for smoother visuals. RTX 40 Series+ required.
Overrides.SmoothMotionApis.Tooltip: Smooth Motion APIs — which graphics APIs Smooth Motion is allowed to hook. None = disabled for all APIs.
Overrides.SmoothMotionEnable.Tooltip: Smooth Motion Enable — Off: disabled. On: enables driver-level frame generation (RTX 40 Series+ only).
Overrides.TearControl.Tooltip: VSync Tear Control — Standard: normal VSync behavior. Adaptive: VSync on when FPS ≥ refresh rate, off when below (reduces stuttering at low FPS).
Overrides.UpdateInclusion.Tooltip: Choose which components are included in Update All for this game.
Overrides.Vsync.Tooltip: Vertical Sync settings — controls how the driver synchronizes frame rendering with your display's refresh rate.
Overrides.VsyncMode.Tooltip: VSync Mode — App Controlled: let the game decide. Force Off: disables VSync entirely. Force On: locks to refresh rate. Fast Sync: renders freely, displays latest complete frame.
Overrides.VsyncMode.Tooltip.Global: Global = inherit from global setting. App Controlled: let the game decide. Force Off: disables VSync. Force On: locks to refresh rate. Fast Sync: renders freely, displays latest complete frame.
Overrides.WikiExclude.Tooltip: Included = this game is looked up on the RenoDX and Luma wikis. Excluded = skip wiki lookups for this game.
Overrides.WikiName.Tooltip: Override the name used to look up this game on the RenoDX/Luma wiki. Leave blank to use the game name. Press Enter to save.
Settings.AutomaticUpdates.Tooltip: When enabled, RHI silently installs component updates in the background after each update check. Games that are running when an update is detected will be retried automatically once they close. Does not apply to app updates.
Settings.CheckForUpdates.Tooltip: Fetches the latest manifest data and checks all components for available updates. Bypasses the 4-hour cooldown.
Settings.HDRPeak.Tooltip: Peak brightness (nits) written to reshade.ini presets. HDR auto-toggle enables Windows HDR on game launch and disables on exit.

Settings.Language.Tooltip: Choose the display language. Follow System uses Windows UI language.
Settings.ScreenshotsHotkeys.Tooltip: Screenshot save path and ReShade key bindings applied to all managed reshade.ini files.
Settings.Title: Settings
Setup.Description:
RHI can manage ReShade across all your games automatically. Here's what that includes:

  - Installs and updates ReShade for each game with one click
  - Keeps the correct DLL name per game based on what the game needs
  - Manages shader packs globally - install once, deployed to every game automatically
  - Backs up any shaders already in your game folders before taking over
  - Keeps ReShade in sync when you install RenoDX, OptiScaler, or other components

If you already have a custom ReShade setup - specific shader collections, hand-tuned configs, or a version you prefer - choose "I'll manage it myself" and RHI will leave ReShade completely alone.
